## Commands

<!-- GENERATED:slash-commands -->
<!-- Do not edit: written by `make wiki-tables` (tools/wiki/manifest.lua). -->
| Command | Aliases | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `/hekili help` | n/a | Lists the chat commands, with your specialization's settings and their current values. |
| `/hekili set <toggle \| mode \| cycle \| spec> [value]` | n/a | Turns a toggle on or off, changes the display mode or target swaps, or changes a specialization setting. |
| `/hekili priority [name \| default]` | `/hekili prio` | Lists your specialization's priorities, switches to one by name, or returns to the built-in default. |
| `/hekili spec [name]` | n/a | Lists your class's specializations, or activates one for your current talent tree. |
| `/hekili profile [name]` | n/a | Lists your profiles, or switches to one by name. |
| `/hekili move` | n/a | Unlocks the displays so they can be moved. Not available in combat. |
| `/hekili unlock` | n/a | The same as `/hekili move`. |
| `/hekili lock` | n/a | Locks the displays in place. |
| `/hekili enable` | n/a | Turns Hekili Forever on. |
| `/hekili disable` | n/a | Turns Hekili Forever off. |
| `/hekili snapshot` | `/hekili snap` | Takes a snapshot of the current recommendations, shown on the Snapshots tab. |

n/a: the command has no shorter form.
<!-- /GENERATED -->
